questions.prompt: Which of these are letters of the Greek alphabet?
questions.fact: Our word alphabet is just the first two Greek letters stuck together: alpha and beta.

questions.prompt: Which of these rivers are in Africa?
questions.fact: The Zambezi pours over Victoria Falls on the border of Zambia and Zimbabwe.

questions.prompt: Roughly how many languages are spoken in the world today?
questions.fact: About 7,000, and around 40% of them are endangered.

questions.prompt: How long is the Channel Tunnel, in kilometres?
questions.fact: About 50 km, 38 of them under the sea: the longest undersea stretch of any tunnel.

questions.prompt: Which country gave the Statue of Liberty to the United States?
questions.hint: The same country later built the Eiffel Tower, whose engineer also designed the statue's frame.
questions.fact: Gustave Eiffel designed the iron skeleton inside the statue.

questions.prompt: Which grain is sake made from?
questions.hint: It is the grain eaten with most Japanese meals.
questions.fact: Sake is brewed more like beer than made like wine, even though people call it rice wine.
